intro.title: Medical translation services: what you need to know
paras: Free or low-cost machine translation tools are widely available, but we recommend caution with technical pharmaceutical and medical content. In these fields a missing digit or a wrong term can change the meaning of a text.
As a specialist translation agency with more than 15 years of experience in medical and pharmaceutical work, we only assign specialised translators to your project.
checks: Translators with a medical or pharmacy background, or more than 5 years of medical translation experience
Accurate use of the language used by healthcare professionals
Native translators in a wide range of languages
Files delivered in the format you send, from Word and Excel to PDF and HTML

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
items: Why not use machine translation for medical texts?
Automatic engines can miss the precision that medical and pharmaceutical content needs.
A specialist translator checks every term against the subject.
Who will translate my medical document?
A translator with a background in medicine or pharmacy, or more than 5 years of medical translation experience.
They translate into their native language.
Does my translator need to be a medical professional?
Not necessarily. We match each project to a translator with the right specialist knowledge and linguistic skill.
The result is a polished, accurate final text.
Which file formats can you handle?
We work with Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDF and HTML files.
Send your file and we confirm the best approach.
How do I get a quote?
Send the document, the languages you need and your deadline.
We reply with a free, no-obligation quote.
